random-studio--sun.why_en: Bounce a giant ball and the sun rises and sets with it.
random-studio--sun.why_zh: 拍一拍巨大的弹力球，太阳就随之升起、落下。

lab212--moc.why_en: Whistle and a tree grows from your breath; stop and it stops.
lab212--moc.why_zh: 吹口哨，树就从你的气息里长出来；一停下，它也停下。

lab212--appel-d-air.why_en: A child's breath on a tiny windmill comes back as a gust from a giant fan.
lab212--appel-d-air.why_zh: 孩子对着小风车吹的一口气，会变成一台巨大风扇吹回来的一阵风。

schnelle-bunte-bilder--panic.why_en: Projected fish come close only if you move calmly; rush and panic ripples through the swarm.
schnelle-bunte-bilder--panic.why_zh: 投影出来的鱼只在你动作平缓时才靠近；一着急，恐慌就在鱼群里蔓延。

christian-holz--imaginary-reality-gaming.why_en: A basketball game with no ball: players only know where it is from how everyone else moves.
christian-holz--imaginary-reality-gaming.why_zh: 一场没有球的篮球赛：球在哪儿，只能从其他人的动作里看出来。

keita-higuchi--dhalsim.why_en: Your live body, but your arm stretches across the room to punch or grab.
keita-higuchi--dhalsim.why_zh: 还是你自己的实时身体，只是手臂能伸过整个房间去出拳或抓东西。

yujie-tao--integrating-real-world-distra.why_en: A real fan's gust becomes wind in the virtual world instead of breaking the illusion.
yujie-tao--integrating-real-world-distra.why_zh: 真实风扇吹来的风变成了虚拟世界里的风，而不是打破沉浸感。

johnny-chung-lee--wii-head-tracking-desk.why_en: Track the viewer's head and an ordinary TV turns into a window with real depth behind it.
johnny-chung-lee--wii-head-tracking-desk.why_zh: 追踪观看者的头部，一台普通电视就变成一扇后面真有纵深的窗。

matt-deslauriers--lumos.why_en: A cold blue beacon turns warm the moment it senses your body heat.
matt-deslauriers--lumos.why_zh: 冷蓝色的灯塔一感受到你的体温，就立刻变暖。

ninsky--summer-snow.why_en: A sunny summer street is suddenly buried in snow.
ninsky--summer-snow.why_zh: 阳光明媚的夏日街道突然被大雪覆盖。

children-of-the-light--zerotime.why_en: The room stays dark until your phone torch hits the reflective tubes, and you get back only the light you send.
children-of-the-light--zerotime.why_zh: 房间一片漆黑，直到你的手机手电照到反光管；你照出去多少光，就只能收回多少光。

jamie-gledhill--portals-for-mortals.why_en: Each doorway of the sculpture plays one part of a fanfare, so the full tune only sounds when a group walks through together.
jamie-gledhill--portals-for-mortals.why_zh: 雕塑的每个门洞奏响号角曲的一个声部，只有一群人一起穿过，才能听到完整的曲子。

palindrome--touching.why_en: Skin-to-skin contact between two dancers becomes audible, so every touch is heard.
palindrome--touching.why_zh: 两位舞者皮肤相触就会发声，每一次触碰都能被听见。

openendedgroup--pedestrian.why_en: A tiny city of walking people appears inside the pavement under your feet.
openendedgroup--pedestrian.why_zh: 一座住满小小行人的城市，出现在你脚下的路面里。

kat-sullivan--kat-and-cassie-make-a-ball.why_en: One ballerina, captured live, is multiplied into an entire corps de ballet.
kat-sullivan--kat-and-cassie-make-a-ball.why_zh: 一位芭蕾舞者被实时捕捉，复制成一整个群舞团。

kat-sullivan--parsing-our-silent-languag.why_en: Body language gets live captions: 'Interested' or 'Disinterested' appears over each person.
kat-sullivan--parsing-our-silent-languag.why_zh: 肢体语言有了实时字幕：每个人身上浮现“感兴趣”或“不感兴趣”。

joseph-delappe--salt-satyagraha-online.why_en: Walking 240 miles on a treadmill carries an avatar along Gandhi's Salt March in Second Life.
joseph-delappe--salt-satyagraha-online.why_zh: 在跑步机上走完 240 英里，带着化身在 Second Life 里重走甘地的食盐进军。

dpt--parade.why_en: Push the lamp and the shadows of two sad vases start to dance.
dpt--parade.why_zh: 推一下灯，两只瘫软瓷瓶的影子就开始跳舞。

michael-fluckiger--elephant-walk.why_en: Ride a bike at night and its shadow is an elephant walking at your speed.
michael-fluckiger--elephant-walk.why_zh: 夜里骑车，车的影子是一头跟着你速度行走的大象。

neil-mendoza--antivanity-mirror.why_en: A mirror that turns away whenever you try to look at yourself.
neil-mendoza--antivanity-mirror.why_zh: 一面每当你想照自己时就扭头躲开的镜子。

red-paper-heart--hidden-stories.why_en: Press a cup to the wallpaper and overhear the secret stories of everyday objects.
red-paper-heart--hidden-stories.why_zh: 把杯子贴在墙纸上，就能偷听日常物件的秘密故事。

seb-lee-delisle--pixelpyros.why_en: Wave your hand and a firework launches from that exact spot.
seb-lee-delisle--pixelpyros.why_zh: 在哪儿挥手，哪儿就升起一枚烟花。
